proposal.title: Shift 20% of the community growth budget into a six-week delegate enablement program
proposal.summary: Test whether a time-boxed delegate enablement sprint improves proposal quality without eroding trust in longer-term contributor grants.
proposal.proposal_copy_markdown:
## Change proposal

Move 20% of the community growth budget into a six-week delegate enablement sprint with public checkpoints and a rollback review after week six.
